calculators.label: Calculators
calculators.heading: Ask a focused math question
calculators.instructions: Use manual values or populate from the current deck. Calculator edits never change your deck.
calculators.context: Context: {source} input · {format}. This is an independent calculator, not a required deck step.
calculators.resultHelp: The result is based only on the displayed inputs and assumptions.
calculators.methodNote: Different methods answer different questions, so their results can legitimately differ.

explanations.hypergeometric: Exact probability of drawing a selected number of qualifying cards without replacement.
explanations.pipDistribution: Allocates lands across colored demand; it does not claim a castability probability.
explanations.coloredSource: Allocates a practical colored-source count from the selected pip demand and land total.
explanations.karstenSource: Estimates the minimum source count needed to reach your selected probability by the selected turn.
explanations.exactHypergeometric: Calculates the exact chance of seeing the required qualifying sources in the cards drawn.
explanations.untappedSource: Calculates only the qualifying sources marked as available on time; tapped or conditional sources are excluded from the count.
explanations.simulation: Estimates the result by repeated seeded trials; it is not an exact probability.
explanations.landClassification: Classifies land entry and cross-cutting attributes under explicit assumptions. It reports composition, not draw probability or a quality score.
explanations.deterministicProgression: Models selected ramp effects as available and resolved at their stated earliest turn. It is a scenario, not an expected or probabilistic result.

relations.range: Between lower bound and upper bound

assumptions.alwaysPay: Always pay when the option is available
assumptions.neverPay: Never pay for the untapped option
assumptions.payWhenRequired: Pay only when required by the scenario
assumptions.conditionalIncluded: Conditional land effects are included in the selected scenario.
assumptions.conditionalExcluded: Conditional land effects remain separate and are excluded from the selected scenario.
assumptions.utilityIncluded: Utility/late-game lands are included in the selected scenario.
assumptions.utilityExcluded: Utility/late-game lands remain separate and are excluded from the selected scenario.
assumptions.noProbability: No draw or access probability is calculated in this V1.
assumptions.turnInformational: Evaluated turn {turn} is informational context only; this V1 does not simulate turn-by-turn land access.
assumptions.normalLandProgression: Baseline progression uses {plays} normal land play per turn.
assumptions.assumeResolved: Assume selected modeled effects are available and resolve
assumptions.inventoryOnly: Inventory only; do not add modeled effects to progression
assumptions.rampEffectsResolved: Selected modeled effects are assumed available and resolved on turn {turn}; this is not a probability.
assumptions.rampEffectsNotModeled: Ramp inventory is shown, but no effect is added to the progression table.
assumptions.costReductionSeparate: Cost reduction is reported separately and is not added to mana.

notes.noMulligan: Cards are drawn without replacement; mulligans are not included.
notes.sourceCount: This is a source-count recommendation, not a probability percentage.
notes.comboCategories: The two qualifying card groups are kept distinct and both must be present.
notes.untappedOnly: Only the supplied untapped-source count is treated as available on time.
notes.pipNotProbability: Pip distribution is an allocation model, not a probability calculation.
notes.sourceHeuristic: This source allocation is a transparent heuristic and should be reviewed against actual land abilities.
notes.pipSimulation: The simulation uses a simple qualifying-source model, not full game play.
notes.lifeApproximation: Expected uses approximate one decision opportunity per turn when at least one such land has been seen.
notes.landNoProbability: This is a classification and scenario result, not the probability of drawing a playable land.
notes.landUnknownData: {count} lands have insufficient verified data for complete playability classification. They are excluded from classified usability totals.
notes.landUnidentifiedCards: {count} deck cards could not be safely identified as lands or nonlands from available structured data; they are not classified as lands.
notes.landDeckDataBoundary: Current Deck mode only classifies lands whose supported facts are available. Other cards are not assumed to be lands.
notes.rampNoProbability: This is a deterministic ramp scenario, not an expected value or probability.
notes.rampResolved: The selected modeled effects are treated as available and successfully resolved at their earliest usable turn.
notes.rampInventoryOnly: Inventory-only mode keeps modeled effects out of the progression table.
notes.rampEffectsExcluded: Conditional or delayed effects excluded by the selected assumptions do not contribute to modeled progression.
notes.rampDeckDataUnavailable: Current Deck mode has no verified structured ramp classifications for this deck. Enter manual categories or add verified facts; unsupported cards remain unclassified.

errors.deckSize: Deck size must be at least 1.
errors.draws: Cards drawn cannot exceed deck size.
errors.copies: Qualifying copies cannot exceed deck size.
errors.comboCopies: The two card groups cannot exceed deck size together.
errors.sources: Qualifying sources cannot exceed deck size.
errors.lands: Total lands must be at least 1.
errors.payLands: Pay-2-life lands cannot exceed total lands.
errors.deckLandRelation: Total lands cannot exceed deck size.
errors.landClasses: Primary land classes must add up exactly to total lands.
errors.landAttributeCount: A land attribute count cannot exceed total lands.
errors.landColorOverlap: Colored-mana-capable and colorless-only land counts cannot overlap in this V1 input model.
errors.turn: The evaluated turn must be at least 1.
errors.turnHorizon: Turn horizon must be at least 3 so the standard early-turn outputs are meaningful.
errors.rampCards: Known and unknown ramp categories cannot exceed deck size together.
errors.earliestRampTurn: Earliest usable turn must be within the selected turn horizon.
errors.effectAmount: Modeled effect amounts cannot be negative.
errors.permanentEffectCategory: Permanent source gain needs a mana-rock, mana-dork, land-ramp, or explicitly unknown ramp category.
errors.temporaryEffectCategory: Temporary mana amount needs a temporary-mana, conditional, delayed, or explicitly unknown ramp category count.
errors.landDeploymentCategory: Additional land deployment needs a land-ramp, extra-land-drop, conditional, delayed, or explicitly unknown ramp category count.
errors.costReductionCategory: Cost reduction amount needs a cost-reduction, conditional, delayed, or explicitly unknown ramp category count.

status.scenarioUnavailable: Saved scenarios are unavailable in this session.
status.scenarioSaved: Scenario saved separately from the deck.

result.interpretProbability: This is the probability of the selected draw event under the displayed deck, copy, draw, and relation inputs. It does not by itself prove that a spell can be cast.
result.interpretSources: This is a source-count result, not a guarantee of castability. Source abilities, timing, colors, and additional costs may still matter.
result.interpretLife: This is expected cumulative life paid under the selected payment decision. Access does not mean the player must choose to pay.
result.interpretAllocation: This is an allocation or source heuristic based on the displayed pip demand, not a complete mana-base recommendation.
result.interpretTurnTable: Each row shows access by that turn; expected uses and life paid depend on the selected payment decision and are not forced play choices.
result.turnRow: Turn {turn}: {value}% access · {uses} expected uses · {life} life cumulative
result.landSummary: {usable} of {total} lands usable under this scenario
result.landDropSummary: {usable} of {total} lands playable as land drops under this scenario
result.landManaSummary: {usable} of {total} lands immediately usable for mana under this scenario
result.interpretLandPlayability: This is a transparent land classification and scenario result. It does not assign a quality score or calculate the chance of drawing a playable land.
result.landScenarioMode: Meaning: {mode} · turn {turn} is informational context only; V1 does not simulate turn-by-turn access
result.landScenarioUsable: Usable under selected assumptions: {count} of {total} lands
result.landScenarioLandDrop: Playable as a land drop under selected classification: {count} of {total} lands
result.landScenarioManaNow: Immediately usable for mana under selected assumptions: {count} of {total} lands
result.landScenarioTapped: Not immediately usable because of reliably tapped entry: {count} lands
result.interpretRamp: This is a category-based deterministic ramp scenario. It separates permanent sources, temporary mana, land deployment, and cost reduction; it is not a probability or expected value.
result.rampByHorizon: Ramp cards usable by selected horizon: {count}
result.rampInventoryTimingNote: Inventory only — ramp cards are counted by category, but availability, resolution, and mana effects are not modeled.
result.rampTurnRow: Turn {turn}: baseline {baseline} mana · modeled {modeled} mana · +{permanent} permanent sources · +{temporary} temporary mana · +{lands} additional land deployment · {reduction} cost reduction

notes.providerBody: The current Miniapps.ai preview environment has no external card-data provider connected. The pipeline reports this openly and does not treat missing card facts as verified.
notes.syntheticBody: Try It / Examples uses synthetic placeholders because a verified card dataset is not available. They are demonstrations, not recommendations or authoritative card records.
notes.simulationBody: The current simulation methods are functional estimates for their displayed qualifying-source model, not a complete Magic game or rules engine.

guide.label: Guide
guide.heading: Use the analyzer with clear assumptions
guide.what: It turns deck facts and explicit assumptions into transparent mana and probability questions.
guide.deck: Choose a format, paste a list, and parse it. Resolved evidence is kept separate from unresolved cards.
guide.formats: Constructed uses four-copy rules, Singleton uses one copy, and Brawl uses 59 main-deck cards plus one commander.
guide.terms: A pip is a colored or colorless symbol in a cost. A source is a card or ability that can produce a relevant mana type under stated conditions.
guide.methods: Source counts estimate how many sources a deck contains. Exact probability measures a specified draw event. Simulation estimates repeated trials. They answer different questions.
guide.pay: The optional life analysis estimates access and expected payment under the selected play/draw, turn, and payment assumptions. It does not assume every land enters untapped.
guide.assumptions: Opening hand, draw behavior, play or draw, mulligans, and conditional effects can change a result. Read the assumptions beside every result.
guide.differences: Different MTG calculators may use different populations, draw horizons, source definitions, or models. Compare assumptions before comparing percentages.
guide.start: Choose any destination. Calculators work manually without a deck; a loaded deck can provide optional starting values.
guide.manual: Manual values are yours to set. Current-deck values are derived where supported and remain editable assumptions rather than changes to the deck.

about.label: About
about.purpose: An independent tool for inspecting mana requirements, access, sources, and uncertainty in constructed decks.
about.projectInfo: This project is being developed as a focused, evidence-first calculator. Developer and organization details have not been supplied.
